blocks.text: Social media, online news and digital government services keep people informed and engaged in civic life; those without access are often excluded and under-represented in democratic processes. In Pakistan, e-government services are easier to reach in cities, leaving rural people less able to take part or use social services.

blocks.prompt: Identify two impacts of the digital divide on social and civic participation (short question 4).
blocks.explanation: People without access miss online news and public discussion, so they are less informed and less represented; and they cannot easily use e-government services, such as online applications, so rural citizens have fewer ways to take part in government processes.

items: Civic impact: less information, less representation, less access to e-government.
